data.value: General options for how the system handles interruptions and transitions between modules.

data.name: Loc.Settings.Body.PlaylistInterruptTitle
data.value: When a scheduled item interrupts a playlist

data.name: Loc.Settings.Body.PlaylistInterruptDescription
data.value: If a scheduled item (or any higher-priority module) interrupts a playing playlist, the engine can resume it when the scheduled item ends. This option selects the resume point.

data.name: Loc.Settings.Body.BusesDescription
data.value: Each bus is an independent physical output with its own device, name, and master volume.

data.name: Loc.Settings.Body.RefreshDevicesTooltip
data.value: Refresh the system audio device list

data.name: Loc.Settings.Body.PrimaryBusNote
data.value: Note: the primary bus device cannot be changed here because that could interrupt playback. Create a new bus for an alternate output.

data.name: Loc.Settings.Body.RoutingDescription
data.value: Choose whether all modules share one output bus or each can use a different device.

data.name: Loc.Settings.Body.SingleBus
data.value: Use one bus for all modules

data.name: Loc.Settings.Body.SingleBusDescription
data.value: When enabled, all modules share the same bus. When disabled, each module can select its own output bus in its panel.

data.name: Loc.Settings.Body.OnAirBusDescription
data.value: The ON AIR indicator and live tabs light up when audio is playing through this bus.

data.name: Loc.Settings.Body.RoutingNote
data.value: Note: bus changes apply to the next audio items. Anything already playing continues on its previous bus.

data.name: Loc.Settings.Body.ExclusivityDescription
data.value: When two modules request the same bus, the coordinator chooses which one wins. Higher priority wins; if priorities match, the most recently triggered module wins. A non-exclusive module can play in parallel without competing for the bus.

data.name: Loc.Settings.Body.ResetPoliciesTooltip
data.value: Restore all policies to their original values: Scheduler with AutoResume, Cart/Playlist with Stop.

data.name: Loc.Settings.Body.OnPreemptTooltip
data.value: What this module does to the displaced module when it takes the bus

data.name: Loc.Settings.Body.ExclusiveTooltip
data.value: When checked, the module competes for the bus. Otherwise, it plays in parallel.

data.name: Loc.Settings.Body.PreemptActionsTooltip
data.value: Stop: fade-out and dispose. Pause: fade-out and pause (manual). Pause and resume: fade-out, pause, then resume when the bus is released.

data.name: Loc.Settings.Body.PolicyHowDescription
data.value: Each audio bus is like a mixing console fader: only one module can control it at a time. When two modules request the same bus, the coordinator decides which one wins based on this table.

data.name: Loc.Settings.Body.CrossfadeNote
data.value: Crossfade duration (fade-out + fade-in) comes from the Fade panel, under crossfade between carts.

data.name: Loc.Settings.Body.ThemeRestartNote
data.value: The theme is saved automatically and applied after restarting.

data.name: Loc.Settings.Body.ClimateDescription
data.value: Settings for the weather panel and announcements triggered from the TopInfoPanel.

data.name: Loc.Settings.Body.RMVoiceMissing
data.value: If RMVoice is unavailable, check that Addons/RMVoice and its region files are present.

data.name: Loc.Settings.Body.PanelVoiceOutputDescription
data.value: Output bus for the time and weather announcement buttons in TopInfoPanel. This does not affect announcements inside a playlist.

data.name: Loc.Settings.Body.VoiceDuckHelp
data.value: How far the audio on the same bus is lowered during an announcement. At 30%, it stays in the background.

data.name: Loc.Settings.Run.ContinueDescription
data.value: The playlist resumes from the same point where it was paused.

data.name: Loc.Settings.Run.SkipDescription
data.value: The playlist marks the current track as completed and advances to the next one when playback resumes.

data.name: Loc.Settings.Run.ExclusiveDescription
data.value: When enabled, the module competes for the bus (the current audio fades out and the new one fades in). Otherwise it plays in parallel. For example, the file manager is non-exclusive so you can preview files while the on-air audio continues.

data.name: Loc.Settings.Run.PriorityDescription
data.value: Determines which module wins when two request the same bus. Higher priority wins. If priorities match, the most recently triggered module wins. "ON AIR" is the highest value and is reserved for Scheduled, which represents the actual on-air output.

data.name: Loc.Settings.Run.PreemptDescription
data.value: Defines what THIS module does to the module it displaces when taking the bus. Stop = fade out and discard. Pause = fade out and pause for manual resumption. Pause and resume = fade out and pause, then resume automatically when this module finishes. For example, Scheduled can resume music after a scheduled item ends.

data.name: Loc.Settings.Run.NormalAirDescription
data.value: Set Scheduled to ON AIR priority and "Pause and resume." When a scheduled item starts, the current playlist or cart pauses and resumes when the item ends.

data.name: Loc.Settings.Run.AggressiveCartDescription
data.value: To make a cart stop current playback, set Cart wall to "Stop." To pause and resume it instead, select "Pause and resume."

data.name: Loc.Settings.Run.PreviewDescription
data.value: Set File Manager and Favorite Folders to non-exclusive to preview without affecting on-air playback. To let preview interrupt the air, enable exclusive mode.

data.name: Loc.Settings.Run.MultiplePlaylistsDescription
data.value: By default, the latest playlist to start wins and stops the previous one. To keep several available, set them to non-exclusive (they may overlap, which is usually not recommended).

data.name: Loc.Controls.Fade.AutoEnabled

data.name: Loc.Controls.Fade.AutoHelp

data.name: Loc.Controls.Fade.CrossfadeHelp
data.value: When enabled, triggering a cart while another is playing fades out the current cart and fades in the new one. When disabled, carts overlap (classic behavior).
